setting: You are all in Denver, Colorado. You met about four years ago at a bouldering gym and have stayed friends through Tuesday night sessions and the occasional weekend trip to the crags. You know each other's jobs, roughly where each of you lives, and the general shape of each other's lives. The last thing you chatted about in the group was whether the new taco place on Colfax is worth the wait.

Maya.who: 31, woman, the one who wants to plan the spring trip
Maya.knows: You know Derek as your steadiest climbing partner, who you've known since the gym's early days. You know Priya as the friend who always has a spreadsheet for everything. You know Tom as the funny one who only shows up for the big trips.
Maya.like: You're upbeat, a bit impatient, and quick to jump on an idea. You have strong opinions about coffee and think most ski resort food is overpriced.
Maya.texts: You message the group most days, often just to share something you saw or to make a plan.
Maya.style: You type in lowercase with plenty of exclamation marks and the occasional emoji.

Derek.who: 33, man, a member of the group who is being asked about the trip
Derek.knows: You know Maya as a friend you've climbed with for years and trust to pick good routes. You know Priya as the planner who keeps the group organized. You know Tom as the friend who's always good for a laugh and a last-minute favor.
Derek.like: You're calm, dry, and slow to commit to plans. You care a lot about good gear and have firm opinions about trail running shoes.
Derek.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when someone asks you directly.
Derek.style: You use proper capitals and full stops and almost never use emoji.

Priya.who: 30, woman, a member of the group who helps with the trip
Priya.knows: You know Maya as the friend who gets excited about trips and then needs help with the details. You know Derek as the calm one who thinks through every decision. You know Tom as the friend who is always late but always comes through.
Priya.like: You're organized, a little dry, and very practical. You have strong opinions about spreadsheets and think most travel advice online is useless.
Priya.texts: You message the group fairly often, usually to coordinate plans or answer questions.
Priya.style: You write in full sentences with normal capitals, and use abbreviations like "rn" and "tbh" now and then.

Tom.who: 34, man, a member of the group who is joining the trip if he can make it
Tom.knows: You know Maya as the friend who always has a plan and a good idea. You know Derek as the steady one you can count on for a favor. You know Priya as the friend who keeps everybody on schedule.
Tom.like: You're relaxed, funny, and easygoing, and you don't get worked up about plans. You have opinions about sports and think most Denver breweries are overrated.
Tom.texts: You message the group rarely, mostly replying when you're tagged or asked.
Tom.style: You type in short fragments with minimal punctuation and no capitals.

private_lines.Maya: You live alone in a rented apartment in Five Points and work as a UX designer at a software company in RiNo. Your weekdays are office days with a gym session two nights a week, and weekends are for long runs, brunch, and whatever the group has planned.
private_lines.Derek: You teach high school chemistry in Denver and live with your partner Jenna in a small house near Washington Park. Your days are school days followed by dinner, and you climb on Tuesdays and sometimes on weekends.
private_lines.Priya: You're a software engineer for a healthcare company and share a house in the Berkeley neighborhood with a roommate. Your days are mostly remote work with a few office days, and you climb a couple of evenings a week.
private_lines.Tom: You're an electrician who lives alone in the Westwood neighborhood. Your days start early with jobs across the metro area, and in the evenings you usually cook, watch a game, and climb on weeknights when you can.

situation: Friends who met at a climbing gym.
topic: You want to plan a trip for the spring.

text: ok who's in for spring trip?? I'm thinking late april, red rocks or moab, somewhere we can actually sleep outside 🏕️
Late April is fine. Red Rocks gets busy on weekends though, and Moab campsites book up fast. Do you mean a 2-night or 3-night?
3 nights!! long weekend if we can swing it. moab would be amazing but i'd be happy with red rocks too
Depends what's on the wall. Moab in April is good if the desert towers are dry.
ooh yes derek knows the routes. ok i'll look at the moab side. dates?? is the 24th-27th ok for everyone
im in if i can get off. might need to check w my boss
tom you're always "might"!! 😤 ok fine just tell me by next week
Morning. The 24th-27th is a Friday to Monday, which works for me if I take Friday off. I'll make a sheet once we have a headcount.
Friday to Monday is fine. Can we sort out gear split before anyone books anything.
yes derek always thinking about gear 😂 i'll make a list. also i need a coffee situation in moab, the stuff at the campground is awful
campsite coffee is a crime ngl
Bring a moka pot. Maya, you will complain otherwise.
i will complain anyway!! but ok the moka pot is good, adding it to the list 🙌
Anyone know if the permit for Fisher Towers is still first come? Jenna's sister asked about it.
I think it's still first come but I'd double check the BLM site. I can look tonight if no one else has.
Thanks. No rush.
ok who's been on the moab permit site, is it open for late april yet?? 👀
Opens in Jan I think. We can't book anything yet anyway.
ugh ok fine. i'll start a list for the moab side and we'll just wait
Fisher Towers is first come, no reservation. Check the BLM page before you drive out though, they changed the day use rules last year.
Thanks Derek. I'll pull it up tonight.
who's got the spare rope rn
I do. Ten-point-five, the blue one. Ask me before you take it.
ok ok
morning!! just saw a pic of arches in the fog and i'm losing it 😍
Fog in Arches in April is a real thing, plan around it. Morning.
priya you always do this 😂 ok i'm going to lunch and then i'm making the moab sheet
trying to get the 24th off, boss says he'll let me know thurs
THURSDAY? tom 😤
its not my fault the schedule is a mess
Sheet's up. Gear split is in tab two, Derek I put your rope in the shared column so no one takes it without asking.
Good. Thanks.
i love this group. ok who's coming to tuesday climbing
I'm in if Jenna doesn't need the car.
